caption: The drawing depicts a metal balance arm with an eyelet at one end and a long, straight bar extending from it, connected at an angle to another rod. Attached to this bar are four evenly spaced, S-shaped hooks that hang downward, each hook featuring a twisted or textured design on its shank. The hooks decrease in size from left to right. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a light beige background, resembling pencil on paper. In the lower left corner, there is an inset with technical details showing a close-up side and top view of the bar's end with the eyelet, with measurements given and labeled "Scale of Inches". Another ruler runs along the bottom right of the main drawing, also labeled "Scale of Inches." The lower right corner contains the text “Daniel Sylvester.” The composition is technical and precise, focusing on the dimensions and features of the object.
title: Bread Toaster
